Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lists the testing procedure
 P1, which must be carried out every six months as 
 indicate by M6 in the above title block.
This document tell how to check & schedule service Transformers 1,2 CT (10,20,30,40,50,60,70) in first unit and 
 second unit respectively this system. in door ,using hallon in first unit and 
 F.M.200 in second unit. Have cylinder containing (78) bonds of Hallon or fm.200 
 , according to unit number, 0.5 inch nozzle and cylinder head provided by 
 metal spring. Two smoke detectors and to thermal detectors including to 
 energized one of two sensor ( one smoke sensor and one thermal sensor) is 
 necessary to energized system
The first draft prepared by eng. Moustfa Awadi, tested by 
 eng. Adel Shawki & Safety eng. Ashraf Gaber at 01 June 2003, 
 revised by quality control eng. i & c Abdl Menem Al Emam & EDEPCO 
 Safety eng. Medhat Kater, approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy sector head of Talkha 
 Power station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa AL Lethy EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet , shoes
 . Etc
The unit and transformer

 of service and 
 isolated
Tools and Equipment
Digital Multimeter type Fluke 85
Screw driver,
 Smoke source
Adjustable spanner, French spanner.
Work to be Carried Out
